title: Mirabel and the Trail
author: Edmund Vasquez
blurb: Ada Voss, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
